glbs: assets/source/roster/<family>/ as committed at 2a68e25d7 (the spec commit); probed tier 0 in vehicle mode (wheels and tracks kept, dressing_* skipped)

convention.hull_box: reaches the hull and turret roof; where a bulky sight stands more than the 0.3 m bulky dressing allowance over the roof, the top is the sight's top less 0.3 m (decisions.md F-B1)
convention.pivot: centre of the turret ring; for a fixed mount, the point it is drawn hinged on (only pivot + muzzle reaches the simulation)
convention.muzzle: pivot_m + muzzle_m at rest, at the real barrel or launch point
convention.frame: hull box centred on x = 0 and y = 0, standing on z = 0; +x forward, +y left

thresholds.hull_dimension: fix when off by more than max(0.10 m, 3 %)
thresholds.pivot_x: fix when off by more than 0.15 m
thresholds.muzzle_point: fix when the world muzzle point is off by more than 0.15 m on any axis (added by lane F-B, decisions.md F-B3)
thresholds.eye_m: kept unless a source contradicts it; nothing measured here does

sources.note: 6.85 m long, 2.4 m wide, 3.65 m high (width and height disagree with every photo; likely overall to the sights with a misprinted width)
about 9 m long (gun forward), 3.2 m wide, 2.5 m high

nose left, gun elevated. Scaled on the frame's 7.0 m hull (980 px): turret roof 2.39 m, commander's sight dome top 2.89 m, hull roof 1.71 m; the barrel reaches 4.03 m past the mantlet face at x 1.43 m, so 5.45 m level; turret front 0.296 of the hull length behind the nose
nose right, firing. Scaled on 7.0 m (747 px): turret roof 2.58 m, turret front 0.301 of the hull length behind the nose. The gun is foreshortened toward the camera, so its reach is not read here

verdicts.note: published widths run 2.4 to 3.5 m; 3.4 m sits in the plausible range and the front photo cannot be scaled

the roof is about 2.5 m (photos 2.39 and 2.58 m, Overt 2.5 m); the 2.98 m box reaches the commander's sight dome. The sight's top (2.89 m) stands 0.4 m over the roof, past the 0.3 m bulky allowance, so the box top is 2.89 - 0.3 = 2.6 m (F-B1)
the ring is not visible; in both photos the turret's front sits 0.3 m further forward than the model's while its rear agrees, which is the turret's length (art, Q8c), not the ring
world muzzle x 4.65 m (8.15 m overall) against 5.45 m from the photo and about 9 m overall from Overt
roof gun, 0.5 m over the measured roof; a mount, so outside the box

overlays.note: No drawing of the M10 exists, free or on the-blueprints.com; measured off the two side photos instead (sources). No generated view was made: the photos settle every number the frame needs except the width.

notes.frame_part: the box top (2.98 to 2.6 m) and the muzzle (+0.8 m) are frame fixes; neither reshapes the turret
notes.why: The model's turret side runs from 1.6 to 2.65 m (1.05 m tall) and is 3.42 m long; the photos show it about 0.7 m tall over a 1.7 m hull roof and 3.7 m long, with its front 0.3 m further forward. Longer and lower is Q8c's call; slice 21 does it.

notes.note: (known before the walk) M10 reads as a small Abrams
notes.why: Same turret proportions as above; Q8c.
